# Visuals by Joshua

> Charleston-first professional photography services by Joshua Smith — portraits, events, couples, concerts, graduations, and headshots with 8+ years of experience. DMV sessions in DC, Maryland, and Virginia are available by request.

Full AI context: https://visualsbyjoshua.com/llms-full.txt

## About

Joshua Smith is a Charleston-focused professional photographer serving Charleston, Mount Pleasant, North Charleston, James Island, Johns Island, Daniel Island, Sullivan's Island, Isle of Palms, Folly Beach, and Summerville. With over 8 years of experience, he specializes in portrait, event, couples, engagement, graduation, headshot, concert, and music photography. DMV sessions are available by request for DC, Maryland, and Virginia projects.

- Phone: 240-360-8465
- Email: jbmsmusic05@gmail.com
- Instagram: @visuals_by_joshua

## Services

- [Portrait Photography](https://visualsbyjoshua.com/#services): Indoor and outdoor portrait sessions starting at $80
- [Event Photography](https://visualsbyjoshua.com/#services): Full event coverage for corporate, campus, and private events starting at $150
- [Professional Headshots](https://visualsbyjoshua.com/#services): 30-minute headshot sessions with 48-hour delivery starting at $40
- [Graduation Photography](https://visualsbyjoshua.com/#services): Cap and gown sessions with 30+ retouched images at $150
- [Couples & Engagement Photography](https://visualsbyjoshua.com/#services): Engagement, anniversary, and couples sessions starting at $150
- [Concert & Music Photography](https://visualsbyjoshua.com/#services): Live concert and artist promo photography starting at $200
- [Charleston Photography Pricing](https://visualsbyjoshua.com/blog/charleston-photography-pricing/): Charleston-specific pricing guide for portraits, graduations, headshots, couples, concerts, and events
